verdict.rationale: The documented API engagement endpoints are all aggregate: per-broadcast stats for recipients, opens and clicks, per-link unique clicks, and account-level 90-day email stats. Nothing in the evidence shows an endpoint returning a single subscriber's history of what was sent, opened or clicked. Aggregate reporting, the UI-level 'subscriber engagement scoring' and the 5-year email-stats retention note are adjacent features and earn no credit for per-contact engagement history.
